title: Find an antiderivative
text: Using integration by parts, an antiderivative is $$-x e^{\left(-x\right)}-e^{\left(-x\right)}$$.

title: Take the limit
text: As $$x$$ goes to $$\infty$$, the antiderivative goes to $$0$$. At $$x=1$$ it equals $$\frac{-2}{e}$$, so the integral is $$0-\left(-\frac{2}{e}\right)=\frac{2}{e}$$.
